fields.label: Script Guidelines
fields.options:
Custom Script Guidelines

Basic Structure:

def execute(context):
    # Your code here
    # No return value needed

Available Context Variables:

context = {
    'messages': [
        {
            'content': 'message content',
            'type': 'message type',
            'from': 'sender number'
        },
        # ... more messages
    ],
    'command': 'current command'
}

Example Use Cases:

1. Process Messages and Create Document:

def execute(context):
    # Get messages
    messages = context['messages']
    
    # Create new document
    doc = frappe.new_doc('Your DocType')
    doc.field1 = messages[0]['content']
    doc.field2 = messages[1]['content']
    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    
    # Send confirmation message
    frappe.get_doc({
        'doctype': 'WhatsApp Message',
        'to': messages[0]['from'],
        'content_type': 'text',
        'type': 'Outgoing',
        'message': f'Document created: {doc.name}'
    }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

2. Database Interaction:

def execute(context):
    # Get customer from first message
    mobile_no = context['messages'][0]['from']
    customer = frappe.get_doc('Customer', {'mobile_no': mobile_no})
    
    # Update customer details
    customer.customer_name = context['messages'][1]['content']
    customer.save(ignore_permissions=True)

3. Complex Logic:

def execute(context):
    messages = context['messages']
    
    # Process based on message types
    if messages[0]['type'] == 'text' and messages[1]['type'] == 'image':
        # Handle text and image case
        process_text_and_image(messages)
    elif messages[0]['type'] == 'location':
        # Handle location case
        process_location(messages)
    else:
        # Handle default case
        process_default(messages)

Available Frappe Functions:

  • frappe.get_doc(doctype, name)
  • frappe.get_value(doctype, name, fieldname)
  • frappe.get_all(doctype, filters={}, fields=[])
  • frappe.format_date(date)
  • frappe.throw(msg)
  • frappe.new_doc(doctype)

Best Practices:

  • Always define an execute(context) function
  • Handle exceptions appropriately
  • Keep functions focused and single-purpose
  • Add comments for complex logic
  • Access messages by index (0-based) or iterate through them
  • Use ignore_permissions=True when creating/updating documents
  • Send confirmation messages to users when appropriate
